title: Acid Mine Drainage Remediation for Paddy Irrigation
problem_summary: Highly acidic runoff (pH 3.2, heavy sulfates & iron) from abandoned open-pit coal mines polluting local water table and destroying 120 acres of paddy cultivation.
faculty_mentor: Prof. Dr. A. K. Pal (Chair, Mine Water Research Lab)
industry_csr_sponsor: Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL / Coal India CSR)
solution_status: Constructed multi-stage limestone neutralization & bio-wetland pilot treating 50,000 L/day; pH restored to 7.1; 4 B.Tech/M.Tech students awarded 6 NEP Academic Credits

title: Solar Hybrid Micro-Cold Storage for Mahua & Lac Crops
problem_summary: Tribal gatherers lose up to 42% of collected raw Mahua flowers and high-value Lac crop due to heat fermentation and lack of rural grid electricity.
faculty_mentor: Dr. Shanti Kispotta (Centre for Tribal Livelihoods)
industry_csr_sponsor: Tata Steel Foundation (Thousand Schools Livelihood Wing)
solution_status: 5-MT decentralized phase-change material (PCM) solar cold room deployed; seasonal spoilage dropped from 42% to 4%; farmer realization increased by ₹35/kg

title: AI Drone Multi-Spectral Soil Salinity & Erosion Mapping
problem_summary: Severe topsoil loss and industrial fly-ash accumulation along Damodar River Basin causing barren patches across 2,000 hectares.
assigned_university: Birla Institute of Technology (BIT Mesra, Ranchi)
faculty_mentor: Dr. Rajiv Ranjan (Remote Sensing & Drone Lab)
industry_csr_sponsor: SAIL Bokaro Steel Plant CSR Initiative
solution_status: Custom multi-spectral drone autonomous flight missions mapping 2,000 hectares; soil amendment recommendations delivered to 480 farmers via mobile app
